value.title: A fronte praecipitium a tergo lupi (Between a Rock and a Hard Place)
value.synopsis: Evangeline starts her rampage against Negi as she victimizes several of her classmates.

value.title: Fallaces sunt rerum species (The Appearances of Things Are Deceptive)
value.synopsis: Negi learns ninja skills from Kaede. Upon his return, he forms a Probationary Contract with Asuna and the two set off to stalk and face Chachamaru.

value.title: Omnes una manet nox (One Night Befalls All of Us)
value.synopsis: Negi finally faces Evangline using his newfound skills.

value.title: Te capiam, cunicule sceleste! (I`ll Get You, Wascally Wabbit!)
value.synopsis: On an errand towards the Tatsumiya Shrine, Negi is guided by the Narutaki twins (Walking Club).

value.title: Ubi concordia, ibi victoria (Where There Is Harmony, There Is Victory)
value.synopsis: Class 2-A battles in a dodgeball match against some high school girls who are also smitten by Negi's looks.

value.title: Cum tacent clamant (When They Are Silent, They Are Shouting)
value.synopsis: Negi receives a laptop computer from the Academy, but neither he nor most of the class know what to do with it. Upon Chamo's suggestion, he urges the class to help him build a homepage. The class's new site then competes against that of a net idol who turns out to be one of their own.

value.title: Aut disce aut discede (Either Learn or Leave)
value.synopsis: The third OVA is a re-enactment of chapter 13: Negi's Mahora tour with the Narutaki twins. The tour shows Negi to several of the students (Yuna, Akira, Chao, Satsuki, Satomi, Chizuru, Natsumi, Zazie) as well as others that he ends up missing (Sayo, Evangeline, Chachamaru, Chisame, Misora, Ako). After being chewed out by Haruna for completely skipping her, a final scene introduces Setsuna and Mana, keeping watch from something on campus.

value.title: Tamdiu discendum est, quamdiu vivas (We Live and Learn)
value.synopsis: Stuck for three days in one of Library Island's basements, Negi and the Baka Rangers manage to escape. When Negi was about to leave the school, it turns out that 2-A got the second-highest score in the exams.

value.title: Amicitiae nostrae memoriam spero sempiternam fore (I Hope the Memory of Our Friendship Will Be Eternal)
value.synopsis: Konoka causes a ruckus with Negi, in the process making a mess and breaking Asuna's alarm clock. Negi and Konoka venture to Harajuku to buy a new clock for Asuna, not knowing they are being stalked by the Cheerleaders (Misa, Sakurako, and Madoka).

value.title: Amicus certus in re incerta cernitur (A Reliable Friend Is Perceived in an Uncertain Situation)
value.synopsis: Home in the family estate for the summer break, Ayaka gets a visit, to her delight, from Negi and, to her horror, the rest of the class. Ayaka's childhood memories with Asuna are also brought up, mentioning how Asuna made Ayaka smile and laugh again after she was saddened by her little brother's death.

value.title: Amor tussisque non celantur (Love and a Cough Are Not Kept Secret)
value.synopsis: To celebrate the end of the summer break, several of Negi's students hold a pillow fight in Mahora's old elementary school building, with Negi in the middle of everything.

value.title: Nihil difficile amanti (Nothing Is Difficult for a Lover)
value.synopsis: To help Nodoka confess her feelings to Negi, Yue gives amusement park tickets to the pair so they can have a date. Yue and Asuna follow to support the two of them.

value.title: Amor ordinem nescit (Love Does Not Recognize Rank)
value.synopsis: Stunned by Nodoka's confession at the amusement park, Negi ponders on how to answer it. Meanwhile, inspired by Nodoka, Asuna bakes a cake for Takamichi's birthday.

value.title: Verba volant, scriptamanent (Words Fly Away, Those Written Remain)
value.synopsis: Kazumi starts investigating about a classmate named Sayo Aisaka, whom everybody seems to not notice she is present, not even Kazumi herself. It turns out Sayo was a student of Mahora Academy during the 1940s — and is now a ghost.

value.title: Nisi credideritis, non intelligetis (Unless You Have Believed, You Will Not Understand)
value.synopsis: Class 2-A finally make their trip to Kyoto, but a sinister group of mages sets its sights on Konoka.

value.title: Nil desperandum (It Must Not At All Be Despaired)
value.synopsis: With Konoka's safety already in danger, Negi, Asuna, and Setsuna, along with several other students, do all they can to save her.

value.title: Difficile est tristi fingere mente jocum (It Is Difficult to Make a Joke with a Sad Mind)
value.synopsis: Asuna is saddened when she saw Takahata together with Mahora's counselor.

value.title: Memento mori (Remember to Die)
value.synopsis: Asuna starts to recall her past, seeing flames in her dream, and remembering the 10 year contract with the demon. Asuna dies.

value.title: Et arma et verba vulnerant (Both Weapons and Words Wound)
value.synopsis: Negi and the rest of Class 2-A are saddened by Asuna's death.

value.title: Mors certa, mora incerta (Death Is Certain, the Time Is Uncertain)
value.synopsis: With the help of Chao and Satomi's time machine, Negi transports himself and Chamo to 1993 Germany to know more about Asuna's magic cancelling power and discover ways to bring her back in the present. In the process, he unknowingly takes along the rest of 2-A.

value.title: Non mihi, non tibi, sed nobis (Not for Me, Not for You, But for Us)
value.synopsis: Negi forms a Probationary Contract with the rest of Class 2-A so they will help him fight the demons and break the contract between Asuna and the Demon King.
